_comment: Shadow Link v3 sample configuration. Copy to config.json and edit. Real env vars override config.json values; config.json overrides hardcoded defaults. Code defaults stay at localhost — set Tailscale/remote URLs here if your LM Studio runs elsewhere.

chat._comment: Local LLM that synthesizes the operator's likely reply in their voice. Point at LM Studio / llama.cpp / Ollama with an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint. If 'model' is left as 'local-model' the auto-resolver picks the best loaded model (prefers coder / qwopus / qwen / 27b / 32b / 70b / instruct).

tracking._comment: Shadow Core: `shadow-link daemon` follows Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity sessions. Folders under 'ignore' are never recorded; raw activity older than keep_activity_days is pruned (sessions, summaries and decisions stay).

proxy._comment: inject_nudges appends Shadow Link context to your new message (off by default; the UserPromptSubmit hook is the preferred channel). inject_synthesized also includes the local LLM's predicted reaction. The lookup runs before the request is forwarded: nudge_timeout_seconds caps it, nudge_budget_seconds caps the LLM inside it (must be lower).
